summary: Iter46 — Per-industry product-tour wiring verified end-to-end. Homepage <ProductTour switcher /> renders 5 tabs (trades/hospitality/transport/healthcare/retail). Clicking each tab swaps the 4 figures to the correct /product-tour/{industry}-{overview|swms|licences|risk}.png with naturalWidth=3200 (real screenshots loading). Backend login owner@safetradie.demo / Demo@1234 returns 200 with industry='trades' (correctly restored).
